_comment: UI-NFR-003 R-013/R-014/R-015/R-028 gzip budgets. #612 executed the mandated lazy-i18n refactor: the feature translation namespaces (pages, enums, glossary) are now code-split and dynamically imported per locale, so only the small core namespace ships in the initial bundle. This dropped the measured initial JS from the 503.3 KB gzip baseline (2026-07-12, budgeted at a 600 KB ceiling) to 343.3 KB gzip (2026-07-20 measure), a ~160 KB reduction back toward the R-013 aspirational 300 KB target. initialJsGzipKb is therefore lowered from 600 to 400 — a decisive 200 KB cut with ~16% (57 KB) headroom over the 343.3 KB measure for ordinary app/vendor growth. Future i18n growth now lands in the lazy pages/enums chunks, NOT the initial bundle, so this ceiling can keep ratcheting down. HARD RULE unchanged: do not raise this budget to absorb translation growth — translations must stay lazy-loaded; keep driving toward the 300 KB target.
